View 4101 Yew Street, Vancouver, BC V6L 3B7, CA rent availability, including the monthly rent price, and browse photos of this 2 beds, 2 baths, 1,250 sqft apartment. 4101 Yew Street, Vancouver, BC V6L 3B7, CA offers 1 bedroom and 2 bedroom apartments for rent or lease. There is currently 1 unit listed for rent at 4101 Yew Street, Vancouver, BC V6L 3B7, CA.
Very recently renovated spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo at 4101 Yew Street,  offering over 1,250 sq ft of living space. This unit features large windows that flood the space with natural light, a generously sized floorplan, and a solarium. Located in a highly sought-after neighborhood, parks, schools, and everyday essentials are only steps away, providing the perfect blend of urban convenience and serenity. There is a pool that is open starting May .Please note:There is a onetime cleaning fee of $375 and a onetime move-in fee of $300. Bed setup: 2 x Queens, plus 2 x twin size air mattresses (linens included for the air mattresses)Free Parking: available on location (underground secure)Furnished units are not available to rent unfurnished.Included: linens, towels, Wifi Internet (free), washer/dryer (on suite), full kitchen, and AC (portable or central)NOT included: Toiletries, condiments (salt, pepper, ketchup, etc.), soap, dishwasher detergent, laundry detergent, toilet paper (2 rolls are complimentary upon arrival), and paper towels* 90 Days minimum rental period* Security deposit required* No Smoking* No Pets* References requiredAll reservations will be confirmed within 24 hours after bookingMinimum rental age is: 25We do NOT host events/parties/overnights in our suites at the momentAll prices are subject to change without notice prior to booking. We reserve the right to decline a bookingDisclaimer: While every effort has been made to provide current and accurate information presented on the listing, aesthetic features such as furnishings, as well as listed amenities, are subject to change at any time.
